problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=3v-8u,\,y=3u-v
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a & 3 \\ b & -1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ c\end{aligned}]
$$

feedback.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=u-2v+1,\,y=u+v-2
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}1 \\ c\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

First, notice that we can express the given transformation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}u-2v+1 \\ u+v-2\end{aligned}].
$$

Separating the constants and expressing the linear part as a product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}u-2v+1 \\ u+v-2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}u-2v \\ u+v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=1+(-2)+(-2)=-3.
$$
